raw_segments.text: There was a report that you were looking for the dog and that you would bring it when you'd found it
Smirov said something of the sort
We've all been trying to persuade Alusha that the dog is alive that it's been seen
The boys brought him a live hair
he just looked at it with a faint smile and asked them to set it free in the fields and
So we did his father has just this moment come back bringing him a mast of pup hoping to comfort him with that
But I think it only makes it worse
